label: managerial or leadership office in
definition: X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or institution Y, such as head, leader, president, manager, director, executive or chair.
scope_notes: Preserves prior managerial/leadership office scope, including public executive roles. Founding, ownership, ordinary employment, campaigning or sporting lead alone is insufficient. Competing predicates are retained as errors, not added to the definition. The full leading distribution includes leader/chief/chair office paths alongside a strong spokesman family, lawyers, accusations and residence. Office is declared without adding those competing roles.

facts.reason: Miller is lawyer in Queens; occupational location is not institutional leadership.
Bush leads Mr. Gore in a bare person-to-person competitive path; no institutional office is expressed.
Burns is State Department spokesman/official; a managerial leadership office is not established.
Milosevic has leader-of evidence but Yugoslav is an incomplete political-entity argument.
facts.reviewer_question: What complete state or organization is represented by Yugoslav in the leader-of construction?

facts.reason: Serbs are driven from Croatia; this is displacement rather than leadership.
